# Analysis to Audience

This part asks how a finished analysis reaches its readers honestly
and in a form they can check. It belongs to the second quarter.
In the single book, this part also contains two case studies and
an ethics chapter. In the three-volume edition the case studies
open Volume 1 as a preview, and the ethics chapter appears in the
Compliance and Ethics part of Volume 3.

- @sec-communicating writes the answer-first memo and the response
  to reviewers.
- @sec-federal covers federal public-access requirements and the
  deposit of each artifact in a repository.

If the quiz at the start of a chapter is easy, skip to the next.
